# BlackVault Group LLC

Practical AI consulting and automation for small and mid-sized businesses. Based in Hampton Roads, Virginia, and serving qualified businesses across the United States.

## Editorial approach
Articles explain buying decisions, implementation responsibilities, security, ownership, testing, and operating tradeoffs without guaranteed outcomes.
